verdict:
The intern now owns well over a hundred repos and still opens a new one every time a thought wanders through, like a congress that answers every budget crisis with another subcommittee. Two repos for the same field log, delivery-twin and field-twin, both described as a map, receipts and mileage. Two turn based topo wars, topo-war and topo-wars, one admitting it is the first version of the other. Two tank artillery games, lob hill and turret sight, with near identical descriptions. Two scope toys, scope-listener and phasewell-scope, both comparing a song to the mic. Three or four things called a synth or a keyboard. Then a fresh dated orange, green and purple repo every day, several with an empty description, like a bailout nobody asked about. Meanwhile the new rocketbench, ghostwing and centipede repos have no description at all, so nobody can tell what they are for.

Merge these: delivery-twin and field-twin into one field log with a mode switch. topo-war into topo-wars. 2026-11-25-purple-lobhill and 2026-11-25-purple-turret-sight into one tank artillery game with a camera mode. scope-listener and phasewell-scope into one listener. synth, tinewood-keys and ether-wand into one instrument shelf. 2026-11-26-orange-bingo and 2026-11-26-orange-casino into one table game hub with the servers merged too. 2026-11-24-green-filecensus and 2026-11-24-green-fleetindex into one repo with an app folder and a server folder.

Kill or finish these: the one letter repo called x, the anthropic-percentage-pop-up-game joke, irrigation-demo, topo-war once merged, skwiggle-v105 which is described as replaced by a host stumbler, and every repo with a blank description, starting with 2026-11-26-orange-rocketbench and 2026-11-26-green-ghostwing, until someone writes one sentence about what it is.

Keep and polish these: 2026-10-18-orange-testbed, mill-ionaire, downfree-foundry, field-twin, topo-wars, ascend, mohavetech-website, shared-server, and blue-agent, the ones that have a clear job and a live link.
